name: multi-finite-element coupling method
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 通过耦合不同子结构有限元表示建立整体系统的方法。
usage_overview: 多有限元耦合方法用于构建车辆—轨道整体动力模型，利用形函数和界面能量联系不同类型的单元及接触位置，实现各子结构有限元模型之间的耦合。

complete_examples.text: On the foundation of vehicle–track interactions, a multi-finite-element coupling method originated from the energy variation principle is presented to integrate multiple substructures, such as bridge and soil subgrade, into the vehicle–track coupled system.

In the modelling of vehicle–track–substructure interaction, new insights have been put on the development of a matrix-coupled vehicle–track interaction model, multi-finite-element coupling method for integrating the substructures into the vehicle–track system, and multi-time-step solution method for solving the vehicle–track–substructure interaction separately and efficiently.
